drug_class: Topical Sunscreen / Combination Chemical UV Filters
purpose: This combination of ingredients is used to protect your skin from the sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays. It helps prevent sunburn, reduces the risk of skin damage, and lowers the long-term risk of skin cancer and early skin aging caused by sun exposure. It is applied directly to exposed skin before going outdoors.
how_it_works: Each of these four ingredients works as a chemical sunscreen, meaning they absorb UV radiation from the sun before it can damage your skin cells. Avobenzone specifically targets UVA rays (which cause aging and deeper skin damage), while homosalate, octisalate, and octocrylene mainly absorb UVB rays (which cause sunburn). Together, they provide broad-spectrum protection covering both types of harmful rays.
common_side_effects: Most people tolerate this sunscreen well. Some people may notice mild skin irritation, redness, or a stinging or burning sensation, especially near the eyes. Occasional skin rash or allergic reaction can happen in sensitive individuals. Octocrylene in particular can sometimes cause contact allergy in people prone to skin sensitivities.
warnings: Do not use on broken or irritated skin. Keep away from eyes — if it gets in your eyes, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not use on infants under 6 months of age without asking a doctor first. If you notice signs of an allergic reaction such as severe rash, swelling, or difficulty breathing, stop use and seek medical help right away. Some of these chemical filters may be absorbed into the bloodstream in small amounts — talk to your doctor if you have concerns, especially during pregnancy. Sunscreen alone is not enough — also seek shade and wear protective clothing.
typical_dosing: Apply generously to all exposed skin about 15 to 30 minutes before going out in the sun. Use about one ounce (a palmful) to cover your whole body. Reapply every 2 hours, and right after swimming, sweating heavily, or toweling off. For daily face use, apply a smaller amount as directed on your specific product. Do not forget often-missed spots like ears, back of the neck, and tops of feet.
